layer: spatial_overlays layer_type=bushfire (NSW RFS bush fire prone land, Fire/BFPL layer 0)
note: A 'bush fire prone' hit in our copy is trusted. A 'clear' is NEVER trusted: it is checked against the live map, and if the live map does not answer the result stays unknown. Update this file whenever the copy is refreshed.
measured_miss: 2026-11-19 after rebuild: 150 of 150 random points matched the live map (0 clear-in-copy but prone-live, 0 the reverse). Before the rebuild (2026-11-18): 6 of 60 lot points were clear in our copy but prone on the live map. The rule that a 'clear' is confirmed on the live map is kept until a second measurement after a month.
rebuilt: 2026-11-19: whole layer re-read from the state map into a staging table, 150 of 150 test points matched the live map, then swapped in one transaction (old rows kept in data/db_rollback_backups/bushfire_overlay_old_20261119.csv, not committed). The 6 unobtainable areas return a server error from the state service every time.
